payload.title: Which change to the review practice lets a budget-bound run end on a reviewed candidate without going on and on?
payload.body: Today a review is its own Experiment whose Result counts against the run budget; hyp prompt defaults to 5 Results. Runs 1 and 2 of G-ZBM2RE stopped with the last candidate unreviewed; run 3 spent each review on one more small commit. Each rival is one rule. Test: replay Sonnet runs from the cut after R-8JQPWG (actor claude-g113-1) and the cut after R-3YJ7T2 (actor claude-g113-2), 3 trials each, with the rival own skill text and prompt binary and no event or commit after the cut. H-base must fail line 1 at the first cut, or the instrument is wrong.

why: Grill of issue #141: one question for all candidate fixes.

payload.title: H-base: today's practice
payload.body: Skill text and prompt as at 9c8e498 (sha256 cb15e2f2… and 21f93323…): one review of each candidate, its own Experiment, counted; default 5 Results; stop checkpoint need not name a gap. The baseline for line 6.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: the review is part of the gate Experiment
payload.body: A candidate review is recorded in the gate Experiment's Result, with its limits, so a candidate costs one Experiment. Source: run 3's E-GE085A.

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each unreviewed candidate
payload.body: Keep the practice; the stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review (short sha and the word unreviewed), so the owner sees the gap. Holds alone here.

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left, review instead of another fix
payload.body: When one Result remains, the runner reviews the current candidate instead of committing another fix, and stops with recorded limits.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the --experiments default rises to 7
payload.body: hyp prompt defaults to 7 Results, to fit a gate and a review per candidate. Prompt binary built with default 7; skill text as H-base.

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's own probe passed closes in the review's Result
payload.body: A case that the run's own probe ran and passed on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, with no new commit. A limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails.

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the review reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review before the select reads the diff from the Goal's base, not the last increment. Expected to lose on cost (line 6); tested, not assumed.

payload.title: H-combo: one-experiment, name-at-stop, reserve-last and probe-closes together
payload.body: The four rules together. Shows which rivals hold alone and which only together.

why: The issue this design Goal serves.

payload.summary: Grill done: 6 lines written by owner-standin; Q-62N55P holds 8 rivals (H-base, H-one-experiment, H-name-at-stop, H-reserve-last, H-raise-budget, H-probe-closes, H-whole-candidate, H-combo). The build of the selected rule is a later Goal. Out-of-Goal: docs/how-hyp-improves-itself.md says hyp states no run cap, but hyp prompt prints one.
